# Bitmap:scale

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--new">since 26.2.0</span></div>

Return the bitmap resized to the given dimensions.

```lua
bitmap:scale(width[, height])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | integer, in pixels | yes | If 0, the aspect ratio is preserved (height must be given) |
| `height` | integer, in pixels | optional | If 0 or omitted, the aspect ratio is preserved |

## Returns

the scaled bitmap ([Bitmap](../../objects/Bitmap/index.md)), or nil if the dimensions are invalid or there is not enough memory
